scope: Read-only feasibility research against Anatomy adapter 4.0.0; proposal only, no new capabilities implemented

limits: Import spec presence does not prove numerical operation or project packaging compatibility.
PATH absence does not prove a tool is absent elsewhere on the computer.
Docker and WSL launchers were located; daemon, Linux installation and solver readiness were not verified.
Rapier and GPU library packages were not inventoried; no compatibility or engine benchmark was performed.
Existing Anatomy tests and historical model scores do not validate any proposed solver.

confirmed_source_constraints: Free parts restricted to box/cylinder, prescribed fixed/revolute/prismatic joints in an acyclic parent tree.
Module shaft links transfer angle/RPM without torque feedback; module connections are acyclic.
No unified mass, inertia, material and fluid-domain contract.
Renderer meshes and presentation cut/explode transforms are not validated B-rep or physics geometry.
Trusted renderer subprocess is locked and bounded to 15 seconds.
Artifact CSP denies connections and same-origin privileges; WASM compilation is not explicitly enabled.
